subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall let planning projection and execution act only on a feature's locked version.
rationale: Execution never starts from unapproved content (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-1, brainstorm:feature-draft#D-5)
fit_criterion: Planning projection and execution invoked for a feature with an open draft act on its current locked version, or refuse when none exists; zero tracker writes derive from unlocked content.
